meta.name: agents-workflow
meta.description: Multi-agent planning workflow with PLAN.md as master orchestrator, stage-driven execution, modular context files, and codejob dispatch. Use when creating plans for execution agents like Jules.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多智能体工作流编排复杂开发任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个AI代理间分配和协调开发任务
copy.tagline_en: Orchestrate complex development tasks with multi-agent workflows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to distribute and coordinate development tasks among multiple AI agents

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 只负责编写和审查 PLAN.md 文档，不直接修改代码。它会先通过问答了解需求，然后生成多阶段执行计划，由专门的执行代理（如 Jules）按计划修改代码。
howto.when: 当用户要求修改或创建 Go 代码，且涉及多个文件时，Claude 会创建 PLAN.md 来规划执行步骤。

say.text: 帮我写一个 PLAN.md，实现用户登录功能。
say.note: Claude 会先提问确认细节，然后生成计划文档。

say.text: 审查这个 PR 是否符合 PLAN.md 的要求。
把当前 PLAN.md 改为本地执行。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude only writes and reviews PLAN.md documents, never directly modifies code. It first conducts Q&A to understand requirements, then generates multi-stage execution plans that are dispatched to execution agents like Jules.
howto.when_en: When the user asks to modify or create Go code involving multiple files, Claude creates a PLAN.md to orchestrate the execution steps.

say_en.text: Write a PLAN.md to implement user login functionality.
say_en.note: Claude will ask clarifying questions first, then generate the plan document.

say_en.text: Review this PR against the PLAN.md requirements.
say_en.note: Claude reads the PLAN.md on the PR branch and checks code implementation.

say_en.text: Switch the current PLAN.md to local execution.
say_en.note: Claude renames PLAN.md to LAST_PLAN_EXECUTED.md and executes it.
